prompt:
Create ONE square 1:1 standalone cutout illustration for a small 48px lesson-section thumbnail in a Japanese self-study app.

STYLE: match the attached paper-town style reference exactly: hand-painted watercolor/gouache, fine dark pencil outline, soft painted shapes, subtle paper grain only inside painted shapes; warm ivory/sand, sage/olive, charcoal, restrained brick red. Friendly, tactile everyday illustration, not photorealistic, not 3D, not flat geometric cartoon. Use the commuter-train finish reference for comparable polish, pigment texture, and edge detail.
BACKGROUND: fully TRANSPARENT with real PNG alpha. No background color, paper rectangle, checkerboard, wash, floor shadow, shadow plate, or stray paint specks.
ABSOLUTELY NO text, letters, kana, kanji, numbers, readable writing, logos, labels, marks, or watermark anywhere. The page marks must be only a few loose abstract pencil strokes, not arranged like handwriting or a formula.
COMPOSITION: exactly one compact, chunky, roughly square silhouette (subject content-box width/height ratio 0.8–1.25), centered and large enough to read at 48px, fully inside canvas with transparent breathing room. Keep details broad and simple; no tiny details.
SUBJECT: one open warm-ivory notebook seen at a slight top-down angle, with a few broad abstract charcoal pencil strokes on the pages and a small sage bookmark ribbon peeking from the bottom edge. Keep pages blank apart from those non-readable strokes. No pencil or extra objects.

suggestedAlt.vi: Cuốn sổ mở có vài nét chì trừu tượng và ruy-băng đánh dấu màu xanh sage.
